notes.title: Patch Notes 21 September
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] - Fixed crazy physics when standing on objects.
[*] - Fixed soft lock with encounter with the final Soul of the Wind in the Snowy Mountain.
[*] - Fixed camera angles when respawning.
[*] - Fixed issues with saving and loading slots.
[*] - Fixed UI appearance issues.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] - Save slots allow for one save game.
[*] - Performance updates.
[*] - Improved highlight when hovering over objects with the crosshair.
[/list]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] - New main menu screen.
[*] - Cinematic ending sequence.
[*] - Loading screen movie.
[*] - Descriptions for each setting in the settings menu.
[*] - Camera ambient motion.
[/list]
